lines.en: Zoe, welcome to the team! When did you move to Atlanta?
lines.pt: Zoe, bem-vinda à equipe! Quando você se mudou para Atlanta?

lines.en: I moved here last year. Before that, I lived in Ohio for ten years.
lines.pt: Mudei para cá no ano passado. Antes disso, morei em Ohio por dez anos.

lines.en: Interesting! I moved here three years ago. Have you seen much of the city?
lines.pt: Interessante! Eu me mudei para cá há três anos. Você já conheceu muito da cidade?

lines.en: A little. I went to a baseball game last month, and I have visited the big park twice this week.
lines.pt: Um pouco. Fui a um jogo de beisebol mês passado, e visitei o parque grande duas vezes esta semana.

lines.en: Nice! When did you start this job?
lines.pt: Legal! Quando você começou neste emprego?

lines.en: I started two weeks ago. I have already met most of the team.
lines.pt: Comecei há duas semanas. Já conheci a maior parte da equipe.

lines.en: Good. I have worked here since 2022. Last week I finished a big project.
lines.pt: Bom. Trabalho aqui desde 2022. Na semana passada terminei um grande projeto.

lines.en: Congratulations! Have you taken a day off since then?
lines.pt: Parabéns! Você tirou um dia de folga desde então?

lines.en: Not yet. I took a long weekend last summer, but I haven’t had a break this year.
lines.pt: Ainda não. Tirei um fim de semana longo no verão passado, mas não tive pausa este ano.

lines.en: You should rest. I have worked hard this week too, and I am tired.
lines.pt: Você deveria descansar. Eu também trabalhei muito esta semana e estou cansada.

lines.en: Let’s have lunch together today. I have found a great place near the office.
lines.pt: Vamos almoçar juntos hoje. Achei um ótimo lugar perto do escritório.

facts.big: passado com last/ago · have + particípio com this week/since
facts.label: Last, ago e this week
facts.sub: Passado simples com tempo acabado: last year, two weeks ago. Present perfect com tempo aberto: this week, since 2022. Pergunte When did you…?

facts.label: Tempo acabado
facts.sub: Use o passado simples com tempos acabados: last year, last week, two weeks ago, yesterday, in 2020. Exemplo: I moved here last year. Pergunte When did you move here?

facts.label: Tempo aberto
facts.sub: Use o present perfect com tempos que ainda não acabaram: this week, this year, today, since 2022. Exemplo: I have worked hard this week. A semana ainda continua.

facts.sub: Faça duas perguntas: o tempo acabou? Use passado. O tempo ainda continua? Use present perfect. Com since, use sempre present perfect: I have worked here since 2022.

pages.title: A new colleague · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a tall office building in Atlanta. A new colleague sits at an empty desk near the window. Her name is Zoe, and this is her second week. Walt brings her a cup of tea and a small welcome card. The team is quiet and busy before the first meeting. Walt wants to know her story.

“Zoe, welcome to the team! When did you move to Atlanta?” says Walt. “I moved here last year. Before that, I lived in Ohio for ten years.” says Zoe. “Interesting! I moved here three years ago. Have you seen much of the city?” says Walt.
